row: Pure Knead Massage has professional in-home massage therapists that come to your house, office or hotel in Phoenix, Los Angeles or San Diego area. They arrive in uniform with high end massage equipment and a smile that promises to deliver the spa to you. We also offer chair massage services for events or pamper parties. Never leave home for a massage again!
